mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph network to the supplied body was most worthwhile: the planned comparison shows why fluid return matters even while filtration continues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the collecting route to the venous junction was straightforward but less informative on its own than the final comparison.

surprise.text: The inadequate-return comparison clarified that fluid can accumulate even though circulation continues; the final view contrasted this with roughly steady tissue fluid.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless: the collecting route and venous junction were clearly linked to returning excess fluid.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: integrating the systems gave the earlier structures a useful shared context, particularly the connection between circulation and lymph return. The supplied illustration plans support that interest, though they do not establish how students would understand the finished material.
